findings.summary: Memory sample freshness is not re-enforced immediately before bounded math after shard rehash.
findings.disposition: Fail-closed availability hardening; re-sample immediately before execution or bind a measured peak before live scheduling.

findings.summary: Position-zero makes attention scores irrelevant for the single visible key, but the math layer lacks an internal position-zero assertion.
findings.disposition: Add the assertion before any broader-position reuse; current exact contract and validator freeze position zero.

findings.summary: Three D3.5 labels are outside the frozen result-vocabulary list although all grading classes and boolean gates are bound.
findings.disposition: Add an append-only vocabulary registry revision without reopening numerical thresholds.

findings.summary: Tier-B caps and cosine floors are weakly discriminating relative to observed errors.
findings.disposition: Preserve a-priori bounds; document their corroborative role and rely on OCB and byte-exact gates for tight discrimination.

findings.summary: The frozen future misderived-tolerance workflow still names Fable despite the operator reviewer transition.
findings.disposition: Use an append-only D0 revision before any future tolerance repair; no tolerance changed in this cycle.

findings.summary: The tiny synthetic fixture does not make route choice affect output and one test name overstates route coverage.
findings.disposition: Rename the test and add distinguishable experts; real routing correctness remains independently established by D3.5.

findings.summary: The committed CI metadata SHA lacks a documented stable normalization although the complete log SHA reproduces.
findings.disposition: Define the normalization or drop the volatile metadata SHA; direct CI and log evidence controls.

findings.summary: A pre-created attempt directory can wedge a fresh private state root after the contract-wide claim is written.
findings.disposition: Availability-only under the fresh 0700 authorizer-created root; reorder creation or remove the owned claim on failure.

findings.summary: The contract code census omits two synthetic-only source files despite a bit-reproduced bound synthetic binary.
findings.disposition: Add both synthetic sources at the next authority rebind.

findings.summary: Shared authority validation length-checks hashes and Git head without hexadecimal validation.
findings.disposition: Add hex validation in the shared layer; the real path exact-value crosschecks fully contain substitution.
